title: Wire the Zig build steps
summary: Add an executable module and a test runner to build.zig, then fix a test step that compiles tests without running them.

objectives.description: Declare executable and test steps in build.zig.
Find a test step that never runs the test binary.
Predict which steps a default build runs.

hints: build.zig is a Zig program that receives a *std.Build.
createModule names the root source file and target.
addRunArtifact connects a compiled artifact to a step.
The test step must depend on the runner, not only the compile step.

misconceptions.description: Making the test step depend on the compile step instead of the runner.
misconceptions.feedback: Depending on tests.step compiles the test binary but never executes it. Depend on run_tests.step so the test process runs.

misconceptions.description: Expecting zig build to run every declared step.
misconceptions.feedback: zig build runs the default install step. Named steps such as test or run must be requested explicitly.

misconceptions.description: Declaring a test artifact without a runner.
misconceptions.testDescription: The test step depends on the test runner.
misconceptions.feedback: addTest produces a test binary; addRunArtifact executes it. Connect the runner to the named step.

misconceptions.description: Building an executable without installing it.
misconceptions.diagnostic: Calling addExecutable but never b.installArtifact(exe), so zig build has no default artifact.
misconceptions.feedback: The default install step is what makes zig build produce a usable binary. Add b.installArtifact(exe).

sections.title: build.zig is a program
sections.body: pub fn build(b: *std.Build) void receives the build graph. standardTargetOptions and standardOptimizeOption expose --target and -Doptimize. Modules describe compilation inputs: b.createModule(.{ .root_source_file = b.path("src/main.zig"), .target = target, .optimize = optimize }).

sections.title: Artifacts and steps
sections.body: b.addExecutable creates an executable artifact, and b.installArtifact makes it part of the default install step. A named step such as b.step("run", "Run the tool") appears as zig build run. Dependencies connect steps: run_step.dependOn(&run_cmd.step).

sections.title: Tests are a separate artifact
sections.body: b.addTest compiles a test binary. b.addRunArtifact executes it and captures the exit status. A test step must depend on the run step, not only the compile step, or zig build test will finish without running a test. zig build test is the standard CI entry point.
